The following events, being non-adjusting and the effect thereof have not been given in the Financial Statements , occurred between the end of the reporting period(i.e. 31.03.2026) and the date when the Financial Statements were approved by the Board of Directors of the Company(i.e. 13.05.2026):
(a) Recommended a final dividend of Rs 0.40 (20%) per equity share of Rs. 2/- each for the financial year 2025-26 entailing a cash outflow of Rs.452.34 lakhs subject to the approval of the members.
